description: Controlled retrieval evaluation for Echo. Near/far items test structural recall; surface_trap_case_id creates a lexical or topical decoy with a different causal mechanism. Unrelated items test overmatching at a pre-registered score threshold.

items.source_situation: A hospital monitoring system emits frequent low-value alarms. Nurses become desensitized and later respond too slowly to a real safety alarm.

frame.goal: preserve attention for important danger
frame.strategy: emit frequent warnings to avoid missing possible hazards
frame.turning_point: operators learn that too many alarms have low value
frame.outcome: a genuinely important later warning receives too little response

items.source_situation: A bank sends customers so many low-quality account fraud warnings that customers learn to ignore them; later a genuine account takeover warning is dismissed.

frame.goal: preserve response to a genuinely important warning
frame.strategy: repeatedly use a warning channel for low-value alerts
frame.turning_point: receivers update their belief that the warning channel is unreliable
frame.outcome: a later genuine warning is ignored

items.source_situation: A chess player voluntarily gives up a pawn because the local material loss creates development and positional compensation that matters more to the whole game.

frame.goal: improve the overall strategic position rather than maximize each local gain
frame.strategy: sacrifice a local resource for broader compensation
frame.turning_point: the local sacrifice changes the global configuration of the contest
frame.outcome: the global positional gain can justify the local loss

items.source_situation: A bank deliberately accepts a loss on one customer segment so that scarce capital can be matched against more valuable opportunities across the full portfolio, improving aggregate return.

frame.goal: maximize aggregate outcome rather than every local outcome
frame.strategy: accept one local loss and rematch resources across opportunities
frame.turning_point: resources are reassigned across local contests instead of evaluated one by one
frame.outcome: a local sacrifice enables a better aggregate result

items.source_situation: A flight-control team reuses software whose numeric assumptions were safe on an older vehicle, but the new trajectory exceeds those assumptions and turns reuse into a system failure.

frame.goal: reuse a proven component in a new system
frame.strategy: carry forward a model built under assumptions from the previous environment
frame.turning_point: the new environment violates an inherited operating assumption
frame.outcome: a previously safe assumption becomes a system-level failure

items.source_situation: A bank keeps using an elegant risk model calibrated to a stable mortgage market after the market regime changes. The model remains internally coherent but its assumptions no longer match the world.

frame.goal: apply abstract expertise successfully in practice
frame.strategy: rely on a formal model without sufficiently adapting to new feedback
frame.turning_point: real conditions invalidate assumptions that were adequate in the old model
frame.outcome: the plan fails because theory does not adapt to the environment

items.source_situation: Each herder gains most of the benefit from adding another animal to a shared pasture while the depletion cost is spread across everyone, so individually attractive choices ruin the commons.

frame.goal: maximize individual benefit from a shared resource
frame.strategy: increase personal extraction while externalizing part of the depletion cost
frame.turning_point: many individually rational extractions accumulate into system-level depletion
frame.outcome: the shared resource deteriorates for everyone

items.source_situation: A subscription company tries to pull years of customer value forward through aggressive fees and extraction, but in doing so destroys trust and retention, eliminating the recurring revenue stream it wanted to monetize.

frame.goal: capture future gains immediately
frame.strategy: extract the expected recurring value too aggressively in the present
frame.turning_point: the extraction destroys the source of recurring value
frame.outcome: short-term extraction eliminates long-term returns

items.source_situation: After a new road opens, every driver chooses the route that appears fastest for them. Those individually sensible choices alter congestion and make everyone's equilibrium travel time worse.

frame.goal: improve individual outcomes using available choices
frame.strategy: each user chooses the locally best option
frame.turning_point: the added option changes everyone's behavior and therefore the shared system
frame.outcome: individually rational choices create a worse collective equilibrium

items.source_situation: Independent software teams each consume extra capacity from a shared API because the local benefit belongs to their own product while slowdown costs are spread across all teams; the shared service degrades.

frame.goal: maximize individual benefit from a shared resource
frame.strategy: increase personal extraction while distributing the system cost across others
frame.turning_point: many individually rational uses accumulate into system-level depletion
frame.outcome: the shared resource deteriorates for everyone

items.source_situation: A video-rental incumbent remains organized around stores and legacy revenue while customers move to subscription and streaming, making its existing asset base increasingly costly to abandon.

frame.goal: retain market position during a distribution shift
frame.strategy: continue relying on a legacy model while adapting incrementally
frame.turning_point: consumer behavior shifts away from the incumbent's existing asset base
frame.outcome: legacy infrastructure loses strategic value as the market reorganizes

items.source_situation: A political institution built around an old media environment keeps exploiting procedures that once made it dominant, even after public communication moves to a new medium; yesterday's strength becomes a constraint on adaptation.

frame.goal: preserve an established position while adapting to environmental change
frame.strategy: continue exploiting a strong legacy model while responding incrementally to a disruptive transition
frame.turning_point: value migrates away from the incumbent's strongest legacy capabilities
frame.outcome: legacy strengths become constraints during the transition

items.source_situation: A relief army avoids attacking the enemy's strongest siege line and instead threatens the attacker's vulnerable base, forcing the attacker to redeploy and relieving the original target indirectly.

frame.goal: relieve pressure on an ally
frame.strategy: attack a dependency or vulnerable base rather than the strongest defended point
frame.turning_point: the attacker must protect its own base instead of continuing the original offensive
frame.outcome: pressure on the original target is relieved indirectly

items.source_situation: A cyber defender does not fight thousands of infected devices one by one. It disables the command infrastructure those devices depend on, changing the attacker's incentives and causing the distributed attack to lose coordination.

frame.goal: relieve pressure on the defended target
frame.strategy: attack a dependency or vulnerable control base instead of the strongest visible attack surface
frame.turning_point: the attacker loses or must protect a critical dependency
frame.outcome: pressure on the original target is relieved indirectly

items.source_situation: A bank rewards employees for hitting aggressive account and cross-selling targets. Employees optimize the measured number by creating unwanted accounts, so the metric rises while customer value falls.

frame.goal: increase genuine customer adoption and organizational value
frame.strategy: set strong numerical targets and incentives
frame.turning_point: employees optimize the measured proxy in ways that diverge from the real objective
frame.outcome: the metric improves while trust and underlying value are damaged

items.source_situation: A university judges research quality mainly by paper count. Researchers respond by slicing work into many minimally distinct papers, increasing the measured output while reducing the metric's connection to the underlying quality it was meant to represent.

frame.goal: increase genuine performance and quality
frame.strategy: use a simple numerical output target as the performance proxy
frame.turning_point: agents optimize the measured target rather than the underlying objective
frame.outcome: measured performance rises while the true objective is damaged

items.source_situation: A museum changes the color of its membership cards while a weather station updates a calibration schedule. Neither action causally affects the other.

frame.goal: perform unrelated routine updates
frame.strategy: make separate local changes
frame.turning_point: there is no shared causal turning point
frame.outcome: two unrelated changes remain unrelated

items.source_situation: A chef rearranges plates before service while an astronomy club changes its meeting room. The events share no dependency or causal mechanism.

frame.goal: complete unrelated organizational changes
frame.strategy: make independent adjustments
frame.turning_point: no action changes the incentives or state of the other actor
frame.outcome: the events remain causally independent

items.source_situation: A library relabels shelves and a runner buys new socks. The two choices have no common feedback structure beyond both being ordinary decisions.

frame.goal: make unrelated routine choices
frame.strategy: act independently
frame.turning_point: there is no causal interaction
frame.outcome: nothing links the two outcomes

items.source_situation: A student chooses a blue notebook and a city trims trees on a different continent. Similar timing does not create a causal analogy.

frame.goal: perform independent choices
frame.strategy: take unrelated actions
frame.turning_point: there is no shared mechanism
frame.outcome: the outcomes are independent
